author: Hero Hei
description:
The VA for Toph from ATLA, Michaela Jill Murphy, put out a PSA on her TikTok telling people to stop engaging with the Avatar, Aang, The Last Airbender movie leak and to even report anyone engaging with the leak. An animator who worked on ATLA also came out with a similar statement. We'll take a look at both and discuss!
